title: Reba McEntire's Daughter-in-Law's IVF Journey Update - NewsBreak
text:
By Donny Meacham ,
2 hours ago
Marissa Blackstock is opening up about the next chapter of her IVF journey — and despite everything she’s been through, she says she’s feeling “excited” and “hopeful.”
In a new Instagram video , the wife of Shelby Blackstock offered a candid update as she begins her second round of IVF, following the loss of their pregnancy in late 2025.
“I know my body can do it,” Marissa says in the clip. “Unfortunately, if this one doesn’t stick, we only have one more embryo before we’d have to go through another egg retrieval.”
Still, she’s focused on gratitude — and the overwhelming support she and Shelby have received during this emotional season.
Read More: See a Dreamy Throwback Video From Reba McEntire’s Son’s Wedding [Watch]
“The love, messages, prayers and support from friends and this community have been overwhelming in the best way,” she shared. “I wish I could thank every single person personally. Just know we feel it, and we’re so grateful. Infertility is hard, but we don’t feel alone.”
A Journey Marked by Loss — and Love In December, Marissa and Shelby — son of country legend Reba McEntire — revealed they were expecting their first child after three years of trying .
The pregnancy came just one day after Marissa’s father passed away, a moment she described as a heartbreaking gift of hope.
But just days later, they learned they had miscarried. “He still gave us something precious,” Marissa wrote of their baby. “He showed me that my body can do this. That hope isn’t gone.”
Read More: Reba McEntire’s Son Shelby + His Wife Hit a Sweet Relationship Milestone
Their honesty struck a chord with fans, many of whom have followed their journey from their 2022 fairytale Disney wedding to their ongoing fight to grow their family.
Holding On to Hope Now, with one embryo transferred and one remaining, Marissa says she’s holding tightly to faith — and staying grounded in the gratitude that has carried her this far.
Her openness continues to shine a light on the reality of infertility , helping others feel less alone in the process.
Shelby, 34, is Reba McEntire’s only biological son. The “I’m a Survivor” singer shares Shelby with her ex-husband, Narvel Blackstock.
Download the TasteofCountry Mobile App Now The pair divorced in 2015 after 26 years of marriage. Reba has often said she “claims” Narvel’s other children as her own — including Brandon Blackstock , who died of cancer in August 2025.
Truly Unique and Cool Baby Names in Country Music Country artists sure do have a way with their words, don't they? And over the years, they've found a way to let their creativity spill over into the names of their children.
Here are some of the most unique baby names in country music. Gallery Credit: Jess Rowe Mike Coppola, Getty Images Sunday Rose Urban We'd expect nothing less than a lyrical name from one of country's best lyricists. Keith Urban and Nicole Kidman's first child is named Sunday Rose. The middle name is a nod to Urban's late grandmother, while her first name recalls feelings of peace and quiet. The couple are also parents to Faith Margaret, whose name is more traditional, but equally beautiful. Rick Diamond, Getty Images George Harvey Strait III Songwriter Bubba Strait — the son of George Strait — named his son after the King of Country. The middle George (Bubba's real name) and his wife Tamara welcomed the boy on Feb. 2, 2012 , and the country icon broke the news to fans during a show in Phoenix. It would be a few weeks before the full name would be revealed, however. Getty Images for FIJI Water Remington Alexander Blackstock Kelly Clarkson and then-husband Brandon Blackstock named their first child, a daughter, River Rose — but their second kid, a son, might just have the cooler of the two dang cool names. His name is Remington Alexander Blackstock, which is the name we'd give an Old West action movie hero. Getty Images for CMT Barrett Hardy-Clay Gilbert Brantley Gilbert's a softie on the inside, but he looks tough on the outside. His first child's got a pretty tough-sounding name, too: Barrett Hardy-Clay Gilbert. The couple have welcomed two others since the arrival of Barrett, Braylen Hendrix and Abram Howell, which are equally unique and cool names. Getty Images for Pistol Annies Phoenix Joeleena Jean Powell Angaleena Presley and husband Jordan Powell's daughter has a name that's a mouthful, but one that has a whole lot of meaning. According to Powell, their whole family — the couple and Presley's son from a previous relationship, Jed — chose her first name together. Joeleena, meanwhile, is a nod to both late friend and musician Tony Joe White and a family name from Presley's side; Jean is the name of Powell's grandmother. Getty Images for ACM Dolly Grace Schlapman Little Big Town member Kimberly Schlapman and her husband Stephen expanded their family via domestic adoption. Dolly Grace Schlapman joins older sister Daisy Pearl (also an adorable name) in the family of four; naturally, her name is a nod to country queen Dolly Parton. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Knox Bentley Dierks Bentley and his wife Cassidy are parents to three children, two daughters and one son. Their girls are named Evalyn "Evie" Day and Jordan "JJ" Catherine, while their son has one of the coolest names on the block. Bentley says the couple like the short, one syllable name . It also sounds like a great professional athlete name, which is perfect because Knox is currently really into hockey. Ethan Miller, Getty Images Memphis Aldean Williams What's cooler than a name with ties to the King of Rock 'n' Roll? Pretty much nothing. Jason Aldean and wife Brittany's first child together is their son, Memphis Aldean Williams. In addition to his first name being a nod to his dad's love of Elvis Presley and the Tennessee city he called his home, Memphis' middle name is the stage name version of his father's middle name. In addition to Memphis, Aldean is also the father to two daughters, Keeley and Kendyl, from his first marriage, and daughter Navy Rome. Jason Davis, Getty Images Tennessee Hawkins Church Shoutout to Boone McCoy Church, but Hawk is one cool name. Eric Church and wife Katherine's second child is named Tennessee Hawkins. If he ever decides to go into country music, he has the perfect name to stand out from the crowd. We can already see Tennessee Hawkins written in big lights on a stage. David Becker, Getty Images Huckleberry Randolph Houser Randy Houser has a thing for unique baby names. His first child from his first marriage is named West Yantz Houser, but we're partial to Huckleberry Randolph Houser. His second child — first with his wife Tatiana — goes by the nickname "Huck" which just sounds country tough. His third child is named Harlan Banks Houser. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Jolie Rae Caussin Jana Kramer and then-husband Michael Caussin welcomed Jolie Rae Caussin in January of 2016. Kramer didn't have the easiest pregnancy, as she battled a lot of morning sickness, but in the end it was a beautiful blessing. Jolie is just as beautiful as her uncommon name. Their second child, Jace Joseph Caussin, arrived in late 2018. Mike Coppola, Getty Images Rigney Cooper Thompson Rigney Cooper Thompson is quite a mouthful, but we like it! Thompson Square’s Shawna and Keifer Thompson welcomed their first child on in early 2016. They call him Cooper, but his first name comes from Shawna’s grandmother’s maiden name. Terry Wyatt, Getty Images Love Lily Brust The Brust clan has a whole lotta love — literally! LoCash's Preston Brust and his wife Kristen named their first daughter Love Lily Brust. The little girl's middle name of Lily is a tribute to Kristen’s grandmother, while her first name, Love, is a nod to LoCash’s song, “I Love This Life.” Her younger brother has an equally cool name: Legend Wilde Brust. Frederick Breedon, Getty Images Raquel Blue Rooney All three of Rascal Flatts ' Joe Don Rooney's kids have great names. We picked Raquel Blue — born in September 2010 — over Jagger Donovan and Devon Olivia, but all are great names. Michael Loccisano, Getty Images Wake Silver Perdue Wake Silver Perdue's name is so cool, he was basically born with his own hashtag. Dee Jay Silver and his wife, Jenna, welcomed their son to the world on Sept. 1, 2016. The proud parents began using #WSP as their son's own hashtag! It doesn't get any cooler than that — except maybe when they named their second child, a girl, Davis Jessie Perdue. David Becker, Getty Images Thomas South Moore Justin Moore and wife Kate's fourth child is named Thomas South Moore. However, his family calls him by his middle name, South, which is a pretty cool one, if you ask us! His other children are Kennedy Faye, Rebecca Klein and Ella Kole. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Royal Tooker Elle King already had a pretty cool name picked out when she and her partner Dan Tooker welcomed their son, Lucky. However, she took things up a notch when their second child, Royal, came along. Erika Goldring, Getty Images Willa Gray Akins Thomas Rhett and his wife Lauren had a big life shakeup when they adopted a little girl from Uganda, and then a few months later, Lauren gave birth to another baby girl. Younger daughter Ada James has a name with family ties, but we're calling out older sister Willa Gray for her gorgeous name that makes her sound like a future movie star in the making. Since then the couple have welcomed Lennon Love and Lillie Carolina. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Honey James Huff One of the reasons we love the name Honey James Huff is because Honey sounds like a name you would call your baby anyway. It's familiar and sweet. The couple have also welcomed a second daughter named Haven Belle and are expecting their third in 2025. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Major Yancey Tyler McCollum "Pick a name, any name." Parker McCollum chose a unique name for their first child with two middle names. The country singer and Texas native admits he was inspired by former University of Texas quarterback Major Applewhite when it came to choosing a name. Tibrina Hobson, Getty Images Baylah May Foehner It's not every day you meet someone named Baylah May, but it seems to roll off the tongue. Baylah is Gabby Barrett and Cade Foehner's first child. They have since welcomed two others: Augustine Boone and Ivy Josephine. Erika Goldring, Getty Images Tex Lawrence Combs Tex Lawrence sounds like something straight out of a Western flick. It's a strong name and one you can hang your hat on. Luke Combs and his wife Nicole chose well for their first child and their second one as well: Their youngest is named Beau Lee. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Krewe Allen Brown Kane Brown admits he and his wife were not expecting to have a third child, but they sure picked out a great name for their son with Krewe Allen Brown. Originally they selected Kasper, but their family's opinions had them rethinking that one. Krewe is the younger brother to two sisters, Kingsley Rose and Kodi Jane. Jason Davis, Getty Images Chapel Shields Kerr Maddie & Tae's Taylor Kerr and her husband Josh thought outside of the box when they named their second child Chapel Shields. While Chapel appears to be an original name for the couple, Shields is Josh Kerr's middle name, as well. Chapel is the younger brother of their daughter, Leighton Grace. Terry Wyatt, Getty Images Merrick Avery McCreery Scotty McCreery and his wife Gabi were inspired by family when they named their son Merrick Avery. The couple picked Merrick after Gabi's father, Merrick (Tre) Dugal III. They elected to call him by his middle name, however. McCreery and his wife are expecting their second child in 2025. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Eloise Larkin Davis Fans of the book Eloise at the Plaza have to be pleased with Jordan Davis' name selection for his first child. Eloise Larkin Davis is a very unique name that is quite sophisticated. He and his wife Kristen also have three other children named Locklan, Elijah and Sadie. Rick Diamond, Getty Images Arthur and Maybelle Osborne John Osborne and his wife Lucie are parents to boy-girl twins, choosing classic, unique names for them. Arthur and Maybelle sound like quite the duo, don't they?
